package.description: Automatically sync files and folders between your computer and Box.

en-US.description: Automatically sync files and folders between your computer and Box.
en-US.longDescription: Box Sync is a productivity tool that enables you to mirror data stored on Box to your desktop. You can then navigate and modify content stored on the Box website through your computer’s native file browsing interface, without using a web browser. Content that syncs down to your computer is available for offline access, and if you make changes to the synced files locally, these changes automatically sync back up to your Box account.
en-US.name: Box Sync

zh-CN.description: 自动在计算机与 Box 之间同步文件和文件夹。
zh-CN.longDescription: Box Sync 是一款生产力工具，可将存储在 Box 上的数据镜像同步至您的桌面。通过电脑原生文件浏览界面，您无需使用网页浏览器即可查看和编辑 Box 网站存储的内容。同步至本地计算机的文件支持离线访问，若您对本地同步文件进行修改，这些变更将自动回传至您的 Box 账户。
